title: ICE FISH RUN
oneLiner: Slide a speedy penguin across the ice, collect fish, and dodge snapping seals!
mechanics: Slide the penguin around a single icy screen while momentum carries it forward.
Collect fish to score points and build a streak.
Dodge seals; three collisions end the run.
Ice cracks and seals move faster as the score rises.
lose: Three seal collisions end the run.
scoring: Collect fish for points, with bonus points for consecutive pickups.
